definitions.record_indices: Zero-based indices into the raw records array.
definitions.timing: Median/min/max of total_seconds across 3 seeds x 3 repeats.
definitions.knn_over_faiss: Median of nine matched KNN/Faiss total_seconds ratios.
definitions.callable_over_builtin: Median of nine same-method matched callable/builtin ratios.
definitions.matching_extra: metric for KNN/Faiss; method for callable/builtin; one run only.
definitions.quality: Median/min/max over 3 seeds after verifying API/repeat copies agree.
definitions.donors: One observation per size/seed; counts verified equal across dtypes.
